text: 南向资金今日净卖出4.81亿元。港股通（沪）方面，长飞光纤光缆、建滔积层板分别获净卖出2.43亿港元、1.0亿港元；小米集团-W净买入额居首，金额为14.83亿港元；港股通（深）方面，美团-W、中芯国际分别获净卖出6.36亿港元、4.15亿港元；阿里巴巴-W净买入额居首，金额为3.52亿港元。
text_en: Southbound capital recorded a net sell of RMB 481 million today. In the Shanghai-Hong Kong Stock Connect, Yangtze Optical Fibre and Cable and Kingboard Laminates saw net sells of HKD 243 million and HKD 100 million respectively; Xiaomi Corporation-W ranked first in net purchases with HKD 1.483 billion. In the Shenzhen-Hong Kong Stock Connect, Meituan-W and SMIC saw net sells of HKD 636 million and HKD 415 million respectively; Alibaba-W ranked first in net purchases with HKD 352 million.
